# HackerEarth

> Technical recruitment platform offering coding assessments, hackathons, and hiring solutions for tech recruiters and developers.

HackerEarth provides tools for technical talent acquisition including applicant tracking systems, candidate engagement platforms, and AI-powered assessments. The platform serves recruiters, HR professionals, and organizations seeking to streamline their technical hiring process with data-driven recruitment strategies.

## Key Topics

- Technical Recruitment
- Applicant Tracking System (ATS)
- Candidate Engagement
- AI Hackathons
- Diversity Hiring
- Employment Branding
- Employee Value Proposition (EVP)
- Recruitment Analytics
- Business Process Outsourcing (BPO)
- Coding Assessments
- Employee Resource Groups (ERGs)
- HR Technology
- Talent Acquisition

## Platform & Solutions

- [Online Recruitment Platform for Tech Recruiters](https://www.hackerearth.com/recruit/tech-recruiters): HackerEarth platform for tech recruiting with coding tests and screening
